scripts.deploy: bun run db:migrate:remote && bunx --no-install wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: bunx --bun --no-install wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:remote: bun run --cwd ../.. check:wrangler --deploy && sh ../../scripts/wrangler-auth-warmup.sh && bunx --no-install wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
